# Summary

The charter includes a section titled "Membership fee". [[cite:obs-de35550c533823877e46988a38ea2dbeb1b1c6ff "## Membership fee"]]

It states that "Each member pays a yearly contribution; the amount is fixed in the annex of this charter." [[cite:obs-de35550c533823877e46988a38ea2dbeb1b1c6ff "Each member pays a yearly contribution; the amount is fixed in the annex of this charter."]]

Therefore the charter does not state a numeric membership amount in its main text; it says "the amount is fixed in the annex of this charter." [[cite:obs-de35550c533823877e46988a38ea2dbeb1b1c6ff "the amount is fixed in the annex of this charter."]]
